# Relations with nothing named in common

*Generated by `luria index` from the record's frontmatter — built, not edited.*


No chain declares an `invariant`, so nothing is checked.

A relation asserts that two documents have something in common. Naming the field that should say *what* — `invariant = "tags"` on a chain — turns that assertion into something a report can check. It is opt-in because most relations assert no shared field: one joining a claim to its evidence crosses two vocabularies on purpose, and checking it would report every such citation as a defect.
